# Quake (id Software, 1996) game palette (gfx/palette.lmp), 6-bit DAC values.
# One "r g b" per line, entries 0-255 in order.
# Source: SLADE, dist/res/palettes/"Quake .pal" (GPL); 8-bit to 6-bit with
# v >> 2, as VID_SetPalette did when writing the DAC.
# Entry 255 (159 91 83 in 8 bits) is the transparency key of sprites and 2D
# pics, never drawn; it is replaced by black here.
# https://github.com/sirjuddington/SLADE/tree/master/dist/res/palettes
